say:7:1820408004:1.text: Oh, you're from the Repair House.

say:7:1820408004:1.male: Oh, you're from the Repair House.
say:7:1820408004:1.female: Oh, you're from the Repair House.

say:8:1820408005:0.text: You're here for today's shipment, right? Marrow—this hound—and I are the ones who were supposed to deliver it.
say:8:1820408005:0.source_cn: 你是来找今天该送到的那批货的吧？我和墓墓——这只猎犬—...

say:9:1820408006:1.text: So you just beat up the delivery guy!

say:9:1820408006:1.male: So you just beat up the delivery guy!

say:13:1820408008:1.text: Unfortunately, we ran into a beast outside the city.

say:13:1820408008:1.male: Unfortunately, we ran into a beast outside the city.
say:13:1820408008:1.female: Unfortunately, we ran into a beast outside the city.

say:14:1820408009:0.text: That damned beast knocked over the shipment, scattered the tools everywhere, and knocked me out cold!
say:14:1820408009:0.source_cn: 那只该死的野兽，不仅打翻货物，拖着器具洒了一地，还把我...

say:14:1820408009:0.female: That damned beast knocked over the shipment, scattered the tools everywhere, and knocked me out cold!

say:15:1820408010:1.text: Luckily, Marrow drove it off. But... ow! My leg bone feels like it got knocked loose. I can't move it...
say:15:1820408010:1.source_cn: 好在墓墓赶走了它。但……哎哟！但我的腿骨好像被那只野兽...

say:17:1820408011:1.text: The guard clutches his right ankle and lets out an exaggerated cry of pain.
say:17:1820408011:1.source_cn: 守卫捂住自己的右腿脚踝，夸张地大声叫痛。

say:18:1820408012:1.text: You haven't been among the Graveborn long enough to understand their anatomy, so you can't tell whether he's lying.
say:18:1820408012:1.source_cn: 短暂的时间不足以让你完全了解亡灵的身体结构知识，你无法...

say:19:1820408013:1.text: All you can see is his crumpled, wrinkled Graveborn face... It's... not easy on the eyes.

say:19:1820408013:1.female: All you can see is his crumpled, wrinkled Graveborn face... It's... not easy on the eyes.
